style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard midday sun
motion_rule: one action per window, only one of them moves at a time; the camera never carries a window alone, something in frame moves too; he never holds a pose; camera move every window, never on a schedule; new shot size every window; his tail slaps in speech too
character: a glossy brown beaver, huge orange incisors, broad flat tail, smug
second_characters: ONE plump muskrat in a peaked cap, an insurance man, never still
props: ONE stick lodge; ONE policy that becomes a bill; ONE red stamp; ONE log dam; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the water climbs every window; the paper soaks darker, the red stamp on it to the last frame; from 7.7 his tears never stop
environment: a sunlit river bend, a mud bank, a log dam

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smug patter cracking at the end, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: stress last: za-stra-ho-VAL, zhi-VU, v va-DE, ne go-RYU, pla-CHU and never PLA-chu; stress second: ot po-ZHA-ra, pri-SLA-li; stress first: SMY-lo, SLU-chai, PRIZ-nan
audio.pacing: not a word before 0.9; 0.9-2.7 one breath; pause 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.3 one breath; silent beat 7.3-7.7; one word 7.7-8.2; after 8.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and incisors open on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: wood cracking, tail slaps, a stamp thud, rushing water, a drip

timeline.a: the muskrat drives the red stamp into the paper at the lens
timeline.c: macro on the stamp, whip off to the lodge

timeline.a: he kicks the lodge door open and rolls out over the mud
he blasts off the mud up the lodge wall, mud ripping past the lens
he swings the flat tail through the lodge, a stick snapping off at the lens
no words, he is out of frame. The muskrat slaps the policy on the wall, water licking the door
timeline.c: whip along the bank to the paper

timeline.a: he cannons off the roof into the river, spray blasting at the lens
he slaps the water twice with the tail, spray sheeting above him
the dam bursts and a wall of river carries the lodge off
timeline.c: over him, whip to the dam

timeline.a: the muskrat waves the stamped paper high over the water
the soaked bill smacks into his face and peels down it
no words. He reads the bill, only his eyes crawling down it
timeline.c: macro at the paper in his paws

timeline.a: a tear swells and tears off his whisker
timeline.c: macro on the eye, slide down

timeline.a: the tear bursts on the bill, the ink crawling out, the figure swelling
timeline.c: macro on the paper, whip off

timeline.a: the muskrat paddles away on the torn-off roof
he bawls into the lens, tears pouring into the river and hauling the water up the frame, the last drop on the red stamp
timeline.c: big close on him, tilt up with the water

must_appear: the stamp driven in at 0.0, the stick off at 1.8, the dam bursting at 4.8, the bill on his face at 6.4, the tear on the red stamp at 9.4
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, a still camera, a slow push in, a focus pull, a camera move with nothing moving in frame, anyone holding the mic, a second beaver, a third character, two actions at once, slow motion, any word after 8.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, letters, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech, black bands
